doc.title: Holly Hofmann interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998

title: Promoting jazz parties in Irvine and elsewhere
summary: She talks about the Labor Day mainstream jazz party she is involved in and other festivals.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Well this has been a pleasure to talk to you. I know you’ve done a little promoting around the area and that you’re pretty well known in the San Diego area. Do you think you’ll be doing any more to promote your festival here, the one you’re involved in at any rate, you have something coming up in Irvine?
Every year at the Labor Day Weekend, and the roster just came out in the press today, so it’s a wonderful jazz party, it’s one of the only mainstream jazz parties.
Don’t they do one at the same time in Los Angeles? The Classic Jazz?
Yes. That’s a traditional trad jazz festival. And there’s also a wonderful festival at Vail at the same time. It’s more of an educational effort.
